name: truly-done
description: Checks that an AI agent's "done" is truly done: drives your running web app in headless Chrome with real clicks and typing, checks each claim on the live page, and answers pass, fail or cannot tell with evidence. End-to-end verification for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Local only: no telemetry, no cloud, no daemon, no config edits.
